en: Fearing that Ji Chang, Lord of the West, would rebel, King Zhou tricked him into coming to Zhaoge and held him captive for seven years. Ji Chang's eldest son, Bo Yikao, went to Zhaoge to rescue his father, but offended King Zhou and his beloved consort Daji, and was put to death. King Zhou then had Bo Yikao's flesh made into meat cakes and served them to Ji Chang... To save himself, Ji Chang ate his own son in grief and rage...
